name: Iso E Super
odor_description: Woody, amber, velvety, cedarwood-like, skin-like radiance
notes: One of the most important modern aroma molecules. Main component of Molecule 01.

name: Ambroxan
odor_description: Amber, woody, musky, dry, powerful, skin-scent
notes: Star of many modern perfumes. Derived from sclareol or synthetic.

name: Galaxolide
odor_description: Clean, musky, slightly floral, laundry-like, powdery
notes: Widely used polycyclic musk. Environmental persistence concerns.

name: Musk Ketone
odor_description: Sweet, powdery, animalic musk, warm, classic musk character
notes: Classic nitro musk. Being phased out for environmental reasons.

name: Musk Ambrette
notes: Prohibited by IFRA. Historically important nitro musk.

name: Calone (Watermelon Ketone)
odor_description: Marine, ozonic, watermelon, sea breeze, fresh
notes: Revolutionary aquatic note. Key in 90s 'aquatic' fragrances.

name: Helional
odor_description: Marine, fresh, ozonic, green, hay-like, aquatic

name: Floralozone
odor_description: Ozonic, fresh, melon, green, floral undertones

name: Dihydromyrcenol
odor_description: Fresh, citrus, lime-like, clean, soapy, diffusive
notes: Backbone of many fresh masculine fragrances. Drakkar Noir note.

name: Ethyl Methylphenylglycidate (Strawberry Aldehyde)
notes: Classic strawberry note in perfumery.

name: Ethyl Vanillin
odor_description: Sweet, vanilla, creamy, stronger than vanillin
notes: 3x stronger than natural vanillin.

name: Coumarin
odor_description: Sweet, hay-like, tonka, almond, vanilla undertones
notes: Key note in fougère fragrances. Used in Jicky (1889).

name: Hexyl Cinnamic Aldehyde
notes: Important jasmine note in perfumery.

name: Lilial (Butylphenyl Methylpropional)
odor_description: Floral, lily of the valley, fresh, clean, cyclamen
notes: Being phased out. Key lily of the valley note.

name: Lyral (Hydroxyisohexyl 3-Cyclohexene Carboxaldehyde)
odor_description: Floral, lily of the valley, muguet, fresh, green
notes: Banned in EU. Classic muguet note.

name: Methyl beta-Naphthyl Ketone (Oranger Crystals)
odor_description: Orange blossom, floral, sweet, fruity, powdery

name: Pulegone
notes: Toxic - heavily restricted.

name: Carvone
notes: R-carvone = spearmint, S-carvone = caraway. Classic example of chirality in smell.

name: Limonene (racemic)
notes: D-limonene = orange, L-limonene = turpentine/piney

name: alpha-Pinene
notes: Most common terpene in nature.

name: Triplal (Vertral)
odor_description: Green, powerful, cut grass, leafy, fresh
notes: Powerful green note. Use sparingly.

name: cis-3-Hexenol (Leaf Alcohol)
odor_description: Green, fresh, leafy, grassy, cut grass
notes: The definitive 'green' smell. Produced when plants are damaged.

name: trans-2-Hexenal
notes: Key component of 'leaf aldehyde' smell.

name: Hexanol
odor_description: Green, fruity, apple peel, fatty, ethereal

name: Cinnamaldehyde
odor_description: Spicy, warm, cinnamon, sweet, slightly balsamic

name: Eugenol
odor_description: Spicy, clove, warm, sweet, slightly woody

name: Methyl Eugenol
notes: Heavily restricted due to potential carcinogenicity.

name: Anethole
odor_description: Sweet, anise, licorice, warm, slightly medicinal

name: Amyl Acetate (Banana)
notes: Classic banana candy smell.

name: Isoamyl Acetate
notes: Main component of banana smell.

name: Acetyl Cedrene (Vertofix)
notes: Excellent fixative with warm woody-amber character.

name: Cedryl Acetate
odor_description: Woody, cedar, dry, balsamic, slightly sweet

name: Cedramber
odor_description: Amber, woody, warm, soft, cedar undertones

name: Guaiacol
notes: Key component of smoke aroma. Referenced in McGee for cooked/grilled foods.

name: Phenylethyl Alcohol
notes: Main constituent of rose fragrance.

name: Benzyl Benzoate
notes: Good fixative and solvent.

name: Raspberry Ketone (Frambinone)
notes: Primary aroma of raspberry.

name: Salicylaldehyde
odor_description: Bitter almond, spicy, phenolic, slightly sweet

name: Myrcene
notes: Common terpene in many plants. Key component of hops and cannabis.

name: Terpinolene
odor_description: Fresh, piney, citrus, herbal, slightly floral

name: beta-Caryophyllene
notes: Only known dietary cannabinoid. Binds to CB2 receptors.

name: L-Limonene
notes: Left-handed form has turpentine smell vs orange for D-form.

name: trans,trans-Farnesol
odor_description: Floral, sweet, linden, green, slightly citrus

name: alpha-Farnesene
notes: Natural coating on apple skins. Discussed in McGee.

name: Ionone Beta
notes: Key violet/orris note. More fruity than alpha-ionone.

name: Isomethyl Ionone (gamma)
odor_description: Violet, woody, powdery, orris, slightly fruity

name: Irone Alpha
odor_description: Iris, orris root, powdery, violet, earthy
notes: Key component of orris/iris scent. Extremely expensive from natural source.

name: Methyl Heptenone
odor_description: Green, citrus, oily, slightly floral, lemongrass-like

name: Diacetyl
notes: Key butter/popcorn aroma. Discussed extensively in McGee for fermentation.

name: Cinnamyl Acetate
odor_description: Sweet, floral, balsamic, fruity, slightly spicy

name: Furaneol (Strawberry Furanone)
odor_description: Sweet, caramel, strawberry, cotton candy, burnt sugar
notes: Key component of strawberry aroma. Also found in Maillard reactions.

name: Maltol
odor_description: Sweet, caramel, cotton candy, baked goods
notes: Important in Maillard reaction products. Discussed in McGee.

name: Ethyl Maltol
odor_description: Sweet, caramel, cotton candy, powerful, fruity
notes: 4-6x more powerful than maltol.

name: Sclareolide
notes: Precursor to ambroxan. Important in amber chemistry.

name: Quinoline (Leather Note)
notes: Key leather note in perfumery.

name: Skatole
odor_description: Fecal at high conc, floral-animalic at low dilution
notes: Interesting example of concentration-dependent smell. McGee discusses extensively.

name: Furfuryl Mercaptan
notes: Key component of coffee aroma. Very powerful.

name: 2-Acetyl-2-thiazoline
notes: Key Maillard reaction product. McGee discusses extensively.
